title: Per-lens answer schema for reviewer subprocesses
summary: Reviewer answers were validated against one static schema whose `scores` object was unconstrained, so a reviewer could return scores for criteria the lens never declared. This change adds `answer::schema_for(lens)`, which clones the compiled-in review-answer schema and rewrites `properties.scores` into a closed object with exactly one numeric 0–1 property per criterion of the lens being run. `reviewers::run_with_retry` now builds that schema once per run and threads it through `run_child` and `build_args`, so both the temp schema file and the inline `--json-schema` value carry the lens-specific contract, on the first attempt and the retry alike. Tests assert the generated schema obeys the structured-output keyword rules for every shipped lens and that a real codex answer validates against it.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: review command entry point
nodes.summary: Loads the lens set and drives each reviewer through the retry loop. Unchanged, but it is the caller whose behaviour the new schema changes.

nodes.label: Lens registry
nodes.subtitle: crate::lenses::load
nodes.summary: Supplies the `Lens` values, each with its criteria ids, that the schema is now derived from.

nodes.label: answer::schema_for
nodes.subtitle: fn schema_for(lens: &Lens) -> String
nodes.summary: Clones the compiled-in review-answer schema, replaces `properties.scores` with a closed object requiring one 0–1 number per criterion id of the lens, and returns it as compact JSON. This is the whole point of the change: the schema handed to a reviewer is now a function of the lens.

nodes.label: review-answer.schema.json
nodes.subtitle: include_str! SCHEMA
nodes.summary: The static schema compiled into the binary. It remains the base document; only its `scores` sub-schema is rewritten per lens.

nodes.label: run_with_retry
nodes.subtitle: fn run_with_retry(...)
nodes.summary: Now calls `answer::schema_for(lens)` once before the first attempt and passes the resulting string to both the initial `run_child` and the retry `run_child`, so a retry cannot drift to a different contract than the first attempt.

nodes.label: run_child
nodes.subtitle: fn run_child(..., schema: &str, ...)
nodes.summary: Gained a `schema: &str` parameter. It writes that string to the temp schema file instead of the static `answer::SCHEMA`, and forwards it to `build_args` for the inline case.

nodes.label: build_args
nodes.subtitle: fn build_args(..., schema: &str)
nodes.summary: Gained a `schema: &str` parameter. `SchemaArg::Path` still points at the temp file; `SchemaArg::Inline` now pushes the caller-supplied schema rather than the compiled-in constant.

nodes.label: extract_and_validate
nodes.subtitle: reducer-side answer checks
nodes.summary: Parses the reviewer's raw output and checks it against the lens. Unchanged, but it is the second gate the same answer must pass, which is why the new test asserts both.

nodes.label: Reviewer CLI
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude with --json-schema
nodes.summary: The agent process. It receives the prompt file and either a schema file path or an inline schema string, and returns a JSON answer on stdout.

nodes.label: codex-answer.json
nodes.subtitle: real recorded answer
nodes.summary: A real codex answer for the correctness lens, added so the generated schema can be validated against output an actual reviewer produced rather than a hand-written stub.

nodes.label: structured-output rules test
nodes.subtitle: assert_structured_output_rules
nodes.summary: Walks every sub-schema of the generated document and asserts only supported keywords appear, that every object sets `additionalProperties: false`, and that `required` matches `properties` exactly — run for the test lens and for every shipped lens.

nodes.label: scores-per-criterion test
nodes.subtitle: the_scores_object_lists_each_criterion_of_the_lens
nodes.summary: Asserts the generated `scores` object requires exactly the lens's criterion ids and declares one property per id.

nodes.label: real-answer validation test
nodes.subtitle: a_real_codex_answer_validates_against_the_lens_schema
nodes.summary: Runs the recorded codex answer through both the reducer's checks and a JSON Schema validator loaded with the generated lens schema, pinning the two gates to the same contract.
